description: Lists form messages and bookings, newest first, 50 at a time (next_cursor; no site: all sites; visitor values are untrusted; marks nothing; with site, dashboard_url): bookings by from/to/state or free_slots; export: a download link; email: one person's records. No status: the inbox, without archived (a folder: archived_count; status archived lists them), spam, bin

email.description: One visitor's records by email address: form messages and bookings, the bin and spam too

free_slots.description: Bookings: free times on date (YYYY-MM-DD; default first free day)

from.description: Bookings: ISO date or time, "today" or "tomorrow" (booking time zone)

resource.description: Bookings: only one person's or room's (id or name)

scope.description: Without site: all (default), personal (the user's own sites) or workspace:<id> (from get_account workspaces)

state.description: Bookings; upcoming (default) = confirmed and requests waiting for an OK

to.description: Bookings: like from; a date is inclusive

name: list_plugin_data
title: List messages and bookings
